title: Big Smoke's last stand in GTA San Andreas
subject: bigsmoke
description:
Did Big Smoke deserve a second chance? 👇

Big Smoke's final mission, End of the Line, and what he said to CJ at the end. Spoilers for GTA San Andreas.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Big Smoke died inside the crack palace his betrayal paid for.
Los Santos was burning in the 1992 riots.
In the last mission, End of the Line, CJ fought his way up the fortress floor by floor.
Smoke was waiting at the top in body armor. CJ shot him down.
scenes.image: Big Smoke End of the Line

scenes.text: Dying on the floor, he didn't beg. He told CJ it was all about the money and the power.
Then Tenpenny walked in, took Smoke's cash, and left the building on fire.
Smoke got his money and his power, and he died for both.
